# /mandao-quick

<!-- mandao:generated by npm run diagrams from core/commands/quick.md; do not edit below -->

Make a trivial, low-risk change without a spec, behind a double-checked gate that escalates when the change is not actually trivial.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../diagrams/command-quick-dark.svg">
  <img alt="/mandao-quick: steps, approval and what it writes" src="../diagrams/command-quick-light.svg">
</picture>

## Arguments

- `change` (required): What to change, in one sentence

## Reads

- `docs/constitution/standards.md`
- `AGENTS.md`

## Writes

- `specs/quick/quick-log.md`
- `(code)`: the change itself

## Steps

1. Pre-check
2. Branch and worktree
3. Change
4. Post-check
5. Gates and lite review
6. Record and commit

## Approval

No.

## Scripts (no tokens)

- `mandao run quick-check`
- `mandao run spec-new`
- `mandao run quick-log`

Paths are the defaults; `paths` in `.mandao/config.yml` can change them.

Source: [core/commands/quick.md](../../core/commands/quick.md).
